shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc 'command -v lore_get_ci_failures || true; command -v lore-query-trace || true; command -v lore_get_ci_job_log || true'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts; printf '\\n--- related specs ---\\n'; rg -n \"usage|token|provider call|round|undefined\" specs adrs 2>/dev/null | head -120"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"validated by\" src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -30; sed -n '1,80p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; sed -n '1,120p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts | sed -n '24,52p'; git diff --check; git diff -- src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix usage helper spec links" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch; git log -1 --format='%H %s'; git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...@{upstream}"
